capabilities.capability: Authentication, rate limits, hooks and ethics
capabilities.notes: Declarative tool policy evaluated natively (allow/deny/ask, first-match rules, JSON-pointer conditions, missing argument never matches) plus beforeTool/approve/afterTool hooks in the Node and Python Agent (strictest wins, hook failures deny, afterTool failure withholds output, approval waits before the durable claim so nothing is left claimed), and a gateway-wide policy in HiveDB with human approval over WebSocket/REST that fails closed (docs/policy.md). Multi-user gateway: per-user tokens (SHA-256 only stored), administrator vs user principal, restricted per-user surface, per-user stores/queues/schedulers, tenant isolation tests incl. WebSocket (docs/gateway-multiuser.md). Tested with scripted providers/approvers and seeded users; Per-user policies (admin-set, replacing the global one for that user) and a bounded audit log of every decision (arguments only as a SHA-256, newest-first paginated API, users see only their own). Opt-in rate limits (docs/rate-limits.md): per-user REST and web-chat limits, per-chat channel limits that stop a refused message before any model call, per-channel webhook limit counted before reading, and a bucket for authentication failures that never affects valid tokens (in-memory, per process). Approval UI in the Rune desktop (card on any screen + A2UI surface in the chat), approval by plain text in Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp chats, password login that issues per-user session tokens (owner keeps the shared token), per-account failed-login limits. Per-IP limits do not apply (the gateway listens on loopback only). Approvals were tested against fake servers, not a real gateway and desktop together.

Opt-in provider resilience in the HTTP transport (docs/resilience.md): retries only for requests that provably were not processed (connection never opened, HTTP 429/503) with exponential equal-jitter backoff and Retry-After up to a ceiling, bounded by the call timeout/turn deadline and cancellable; timeouts, other 5xx, 4xx and partial responses are never repeated; per-provider circuit breaker that fails fast without sending and probes once after the cool-down. Rust/Node/Python tests against scripted local servers; not evaluated against real providers. Pending: shared breaker state, metrics/events of retries, retry of tool and MCP operations (deliberately not done: uncertain)
